research_question: How effectively and reliably does the verification-guided HapRepair Skill reduce HomeCheck-detected performance and security alerts across the fixed 35-project corpus?
null_hypothesis: The HapRepair Skill does not produce a positive net reduction in HomeCheck target alerts under the frozen five-scan protocol.
alternative_hypothesis: The HapRepair Skill produces a positive net reduction in HomeCheck target alerts under the frozen five-scan protocol.
research_objective: Measure alert elimination, introduced alerts, validation outcomes, per-rule behavior, and efficiency when the coding agent uses the installed HapRepair Skill with deterministic localization, bundled static repair guides, and verification-guided iteration.

model.temperature: not explicitly configurable through the frozen Codex harness
model.nondeterminism_note: A single run remains potentially nondeterministic even without an exposed sampling-temperature control.

common_contract.source_diff_gate: Validation requires a real ArkTS/TypeScript source diff relative to the active round snapshot.
common_contract.target_coverage_gate: Every affected file for every required rule in the frozen round plan must be completed or concretely blocked before a validation scan is consumed.
common_contract.candidate_retention: Retain the active candidate after structural, public-API, configured build, or configured test failure and continue repair in the same round; build/test failure consumes no HomeCheck validation scan.
common_contract.best_valid_selection: Before the evaluator-only final scan, restore the valid candidate with the lexicographically best score over final alerts, introduced alerts, changed source files, and round.
common_contract.build_test_policy: Use only evaluator gates frozen as available in the input manifest; otherwise label the project statically validated only.
common_contract.arkts_diagnostic_policy: For configured builds, compiler ignoreWarning applies only to ArkTS checker diagnostics; later compilation, resolution, packaging, and process failures remain fatal.

scheduling.round_target_policy: Attempt every currently localized rule and every affected file before validation.
scheduling.complete_cluster_policy: For every current rule, inspect every affected file and account for all localized instances before validation.
scheduling.preflight_policy: Structural, public-API, build, and test failures are repaired on the same active-round agent thread without consuming a HomeCheck scan; no new alert rule is scheduled while recovery is pending.
scheduling.homogeneous_batch_policy: Use reviewed mechanical batching for a demonstrated homogeneous transformation; the smallest safe edit is per instance, not a cap on files.
scheduling.interaction_policy: Feed residual, introduced, and non-causal rule-interaction observations into later rounds.

dataset.source_identity: Per-project commit, Git tree OID, and source-content tree hash are frozen and rechecked at condition start.
dataset.selection: Outcome-independent, defect-enriched purposive sample recovered before formal repair outcomes were observed.

execution.evaluation_date_policy: Formal run manifests record exact UTC start/completion timestamps; execution is authorized no earlier than 2026-08-04 (Asia/Shanghai).
execution.host_path_policy: HomeCheck subprocesses prepend the frozen DevEco Node bin directory instead of inheriting launcher-specific PATH contents.
execution.retry_policy: Do not automatically rerun a stochastic condition. Agent-internal no-diff and coverage retries are bounded by the round protocol. An external retry requires a documented infrastructure failure before usable condition evidence and a new audited run ID.
execution.abort_policy: On the first condition failure, stop launching new conditions, let already active conditions finish, preserve all directories and logs, and mark the scheduler stopped.
execution.resume_policy: A resumed scheduler may skip hash-matching completed conditions and launch untouched conditions. Any incomplete condition directory blocks resume pending audit; it is never deleted or silently reused.
execution.skill_delivery_policy: Copy the frozen v7 Skill into the isolated run-local CODEX_HOME. The evaluator invokes its bundled candidate-session controller, while the agent receives the installed Skill, frozen plan, completion path, and gate feedback.
execution.toolchain_mount_policy: Mount the complete DevEco command-line-tools tree read-only and overlay only CodeLinter's result directory with an isolated per-condition writable directory.

formal_run.predecessor: v6 was stopped before its first validation scan when HomeCheck and candidate state moved into the Skill boundary

stop_condition: Stop early only when an accepted candidate has zero target findings; otherwise stop after five post-edit validation scans and then restore best-valid for the evaluator-only final scan.
abandonment_condition: Stop and preserve evidence on input/protocol/model/provider drift, scanner or candidate-session failure, restricted-artifact access, bounded edit-retry exhaustion, or an incomplete formal condition.

reporting.primary: Full 35-project descriptive aggregate and per-project/per-rule results.
reporting.sensitivity: Repeat aggregate reporting over 34 projects after excluding development-exposed wifi_testapp.
reporting.development_exposure: wifi_testapp remains in the fixed corpus but is not described as untouched generalization evidence.
reporting.security_scope: Security evidence is preliminary and limited to the three security rules observed in this corpus.

claim_boundary: HomeCheck alert elimination is not semantic correctness; real-project results apply only to detected defects, natural-project recall remains unknown, and statically validated projects are labeled explicitly.

repair_references.delivery: installed Codex Skill with one deterministic Markdown guide per rule
repair_references.access_contract: For every covered target rule, open the exact static guide before repair, record its exact path in the completion report, and pass trace-based access audit before preflight.
repair_references.claim_boundary: Guide use is part of the method and is not described as RAG or retrieval.
